skills.name: Basic Attack: Making Rice Cakes
skills.description:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 attacks, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Basic Attack: Making Rice Cakes (Frosted Banner)
skills.description:
When Frosted Banner is active, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 faster attacks in front, dealing Ice DMG.

skills.name: Special Attack: Cooling Bento
skills.description:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Soukaku releases a wind current in front of her and unleashes her finishing move, dealing Ice DMG.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
Holding [Special Attack] while using this skill allows for a quick transition to Fly the Flag.

skills.name: EX Special Attack: Fanning Mosquitoes
skills.description:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Releases wind currents of extended range in front of her, dealing massive Ice DMG.
This skill can be triggered consecutively by pressing repeatedly. Each use consumes a specified amount of Energy. When Soukaku's Energy is depleted, or you stop pressing the button, she unleashes a powerful finishing move that deals massive Ice DMG.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
Holding [Special Attack] while using this skill allows for a quick transition to Fly the Flag.

skills.name: Special Attack: Rally!
skills.description:
Hold [Special Attack] to activate:
Soukaku plunges her weapon into the ground, morphs it into a flag, and launches Fly the Flag, dealing Ice DMG. Hitting an enemy with Fly the Flag triggers a Quick Assist.
Pressing [Basic Attack] or [Special Attack] after Fly the Flag activates a Special Attack as she retracts the flag, dealing Ice DMG.
If Soukaku owns 3 stacks of Vortex on using Fly the Flag, she consumes all 3 stacks and enters the Frosted Banner state. In the Frosted Banner state, she can unleash an enhanced Basic Attack or an enhanced Dash Attack, dealing massive Ice DMG. This effect can last up to 45s or stack up to 6 times.
Soukaku's weapon gains Vortexes in the following circumstances:
Gains 1 stack of Vortex when launching an EX Special Attack,
Gains 1 stack of Vortex when launching a Chain Attack,
Gains 3 stacks of Vortex when launching an Ultimate.
Soukaku can accumulate a maximum of 3 stacks of Vortex.

numbers.name: Quick Fly the Flag DMG Multiplier
Quick Fly the Flag Daze Multiplier

skills.name: Dodge: Grab a Bite
skills.description:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Dash Attack: 50/50
skills.description:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.

skills.name: Dash Attack: 50/50 (Frosted Banner)
skills.description:
When Frosted Banner is active, press [Basic Attack] during a Dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.

skills.name: Dodge Counter: Away From My Snacks
skills.description:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Chain Attack: Pudding Slash
skills.description:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Soukaku quickly unleashes a series of strikes at enemies in front of her and follows up with Fly the Flag, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Ultimate: Jumbo Pudding Slash
skills.description:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Soukaku quickly unleashes an extended series of strikes at enemies in front of her and follows up with Fly the Flag, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, Soukaku enters the Masked state, increasing her CRIT Rate by 15% for 15s.
Upon activating this skill, other squad members recover 10 Energy. The next character to switch in gains an additional 20 Energy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Quick Assist: A Set for Two
skills.description:
When the active character is launched, press [Assist] to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Defensive Assist: Guarding Tactics
skills.description:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Assist] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

skills.name: Assist Follow-Up: Sweeping Strike
skills.description:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Charges and strikes enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Holding [Basic Attack] while using this skill allows for a quick transition to Fly the Flag.

skills.name: Core Passive: Blade Banner
skills.description: When Soukaku launches Fly the Flag, her ATK is increased by 20% of her initial ATK, up to 500, for 22s. When consuming Vortex during Fly the Flag, the ATK increase is doubled, up to a max of 1,000. This buff can be passed along to characters switching in via Quick Assists or Chain Attacks triggered by Fly the Flag, and it refreshes the duration of the buff.

skills.name: Additional Ability: Group Set Meal
skills.description:
When another character in your squad shares the same Attribute or Faction:
When Soukaku consumes Vortex to activate Fly the Flag, the Ice DMG of all squad members is increased by 20% for 22s.

mindscapes.name: Uplifting Current
mindscapes.description: When Soukaku triggers Core Passive: Blade Banner or Additional Ability: Group Set Meal, the buff duration is increased by 8s.

mindscapes.name: Experimental Charging Module
mindscapes.description:
When Soukaku's Basic Attack, Dash Attack, Dodge Counter, or Quick Assist hits an enemy, there's a 15% chance she gains 1 stack of Vortex, triggering up to once per second.
When Vortex reaches max stacks, any additional stacks grant Soukaku 1.2 Energy instead.

mindscapes.name: Attendance Meal Allowance
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

mindscapes.name: Hypothermia
mindscapes.description: If an enemy is hit by Fly the Flag, the target's Ice RES is reduced by 10% for 8s.

mindscapes.name: Late-Night Snacks
mindscapes.description: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

mindscapes.name: Northern Wind
mindscapes.description: While in the Frosted Banner state, the number of usable enhanced Basic Attacks and enhanced Dash Attacks is increased to 12, and also deal 45% more DMG.
